question: What should be colored with the fluid and to what extent in the body?
premises: The fluid is the means of coloring.
The coloring should be applied to all.
This includes the pores of the body and so forth.
inference: One should color the entire body, beginning with the pores, using the fluid.
plain_english: O beloved, one should color everything, beginning with the pores of the body, with the fluid.
